page.layout: One printed page: running head at top, then the text block of four lines; below it, a central ornament (no text).

main_text.p: tia prosequemini. Valete Illustrissimi Principes, Domini clementissimi. Argentinae decimoseptimo Calendis Augu-sti. Anno recuperatae per CHRISTUM salutis M. D. LXXXVII.

page.notes: The text is the end of the preface, continued from the previous page; the first word is a fragment ("tia") and is left as printed. The running head is in spaced capitals. The page has no page number. Below the text is a decorative woodcut ornament with no printed words. The right edge of the scan is cut off.
